title: Everest Loses At 10,211 Meters From The Base
hook: Everest is tallest only when the measurement starts at sea level.
closing: Every record depends on its starting line, so the definition decides the winner.
question: Which mountain counts as highest?

segments.say: Everest reaches 8,849 meters above sea level. That familiar starting line makes it the official tallest peak.
Mauna Kea measures 10,211 meters from its base. Most of the taller mountain is hidden underwater.
Chimborazo extends 13.4 kilometers beyond a round Earth. The planet's shape pushes its summit farthest from the center.
